stem: A New Jersey life policy with a 2-year incontestable period is reinstated after a lapse. For how long can the insurer contest it because of misstatements in the reinstatement application?
options: For 2 years after reinstatement
It cannot be contested at all
Only for what is left of the original 2 years
For as long as the policy stays in force

stem: Maria's beneficiary receives a $300,000 lump-sum death benefit from her life policy. For federal income tax purposes, the death benefit is generally:
options: Fully taxable as ordinary income
Taxable only above the premiums Maria paid
Taxed as a long-term capital gain
Excluded from the beneficiary's gross income
key: Excluded from the beneficiary's gross income

stem: An unrelated investor buys an existing $500,000 life policy from the insured for $60,000, then pays $40,000 in premiums before the insured dies. Under the transfer-for-value rule, how much of the death benefit is excluded from the investor's income?
Under Section 1035, which of the following exchanges can be made without recognizing gain or loss?
options: A life insurance policy for an annuity
An annuity for a life insurance policy
An annuity for a bank certificate of deposit
A life insurance policy for mutual fund shares
key: A life insurance policy for an annuity

stem: A client wants to exchange her deferred annuity under Section 1035 without recognizing gain. Which of the following can she receive in the exchange?
options: A whole life policy
A term life policy
Another annuity contract
An endowment policy

stem: A 52-year-old withdraws $20,000 from a nonqualified deferred annuity. $8,000 of it is taxable earnings, and no exception applies. What is the additional federal penalty tax?
The 10% federal penalty on premature annuity distributions does not apply to distributions made on or after the date the taxpayer reaches age:
A life insurance policy issued in 2026 is classified as a modified endowment contract when it:
options: Fails the 7-year surrender test
Meets the 7-pay test but carries a large loan
Has a face amount over $1 million
Fails the 7-pay test

stem: A policyowner exchanges a modified endowment contract for a new life insurance policy. For tax purposes, the new policy is:
options: Also a modified endowment contract
A standard life policy if it passes the 7-pay test
A standard life policy once 7 years pass
A modified endowment contract only if surrendered

stem: An insured who is terminally ill receives an accelerated death benefit from her life policy. Under federal tax law, the payment is treated as:
options: Ordinary income in the year received
An amount paid by reason of the insured's death
A taxable return of the premiums paid
A policy loan that must be repaid
key: An amount paid by reason of the insured's death

stem: Besides terminally ill insureds, federal tax law also treats accelerated death benefits as paid by reason of death when the insured is:
options: Permanently unemployed
Over age 65
Chronically ill
Recovering from surgery

stem: An insurer's claim unit routinely denies life claims that show any red flag, without first gathering the information available to it. Which New Jersey rule does this practice violate?
options: The 60-day death claim settlement rule
The 2-year incontestable provision
The entire contract provision
The unfair claim settlement practices rule
key: The unfair claim settlement practices rule
